title: Microsoft Teams: call history, voicemail and recordings in separate tabs per phone line
summary: The briefing accurately reports the rollout, automatic enablement and alternate-line controls, and explicitly identifies the disagreement between Microsoft's notice and Learn. The licensing model needs a minor correction: the tabs are a new view inside the licensed Teams Phone product, whose general licensing requirements are published, even though no tabs-specific licence or charge is published.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence, meter or charge specific to the new per-line tabs is published in the sources checked.
claims.quote: Searched: "multi-line" "call history" "tabs" licensing Teams Phone; read roadmap record, MC1484013, multi-line and Microsoft Teams add-on licenses. General Teams Phone licensing is stated; no tabs-specific licence, meter or charge was found.

claims.claim: The licensing model is unknown because tabs-specific licensing is not published.
claims.quote: Alternate lines have the same licensing requirements as the user’s primary phone number.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to "included". Replace licensing.notes with "A new Calls app view for users who already have Teams Phone and multi-line calling configured. Alternate lines have the same licensing requirements as the user's primary phone number. No licence or charge specific to the tabs is published." The product-level requirement is documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/multi-line; this is the standard's minor understatement, not an assertion of a tabs-specific charge.
